summary: Riskified Ltd., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting held on August 6, 2026, in Tel Aviv, Israel. Shareholders voted to approve all proposals set forth in the June 30, 2026 proxy statement, as required under the Israel Companies Law and the company's articles of association. No special-situation event such as a transaction, strategic action, or management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine meeting-results report, incorporated by reference into the company's existing Form S-8 registration statements. No material structural or financial terms are present; no further action or risk-arbitrage angle applies.
